irregularities.text: The official Week 10 page URL (/injuries/league/2026/REG10) carries the title and heading 'Week 11 of the 2026 Season' while its body table heading reads 'Injuries - WEEK 10' and the games shown are Week 10 games (12-16 Nov 2026). Cause not determinable from the page; treat the title as an unexplained label.
The default https://www.nfl.com/injuries/ page now shows Week 11 (Thursday 19 Nov, IND vs HOU first). Any repository text that calls the Week 10 capture 'current' is out of date.

Retrieval date conflict inside the repository: injuries.html says the Week 10 report was 'retrieved on 14 Nov 2026', while decision-desk/data/captures/manifest.json records CAP-01 at 2026-11-16T01:17:10Z and COORDINATION.md records 2026-11-16. The published date is not reconciled.

Row counts differ across repository artifacts: injuries.html publishes 160 explicit-status rows; the capture manifest records 347 parsed rows; the brief cites 254 and 279. None of these totals was re-counted against the full official report in this check; the full count remains open.

The official Week 10 page is not a verifiable snapshot: it can be edited after the fact by the publisher. The repository's hash-retained capture (decision-desk CAP-01) is the only retained copy, and it is not a substitute for a time-stamped official archive.
